items.quote: Milcah, she hath also born children unto thy brother Nahor; Huz his firstborn, and Buz his brother, and Kemuel the father of Aram, And Chesed, and Hazo, and Pildash, and Jidlaph, and Bethuel.
items.claim: Milcah bore children to Abraham's brother Nahor, named Huz, Buz, Kemuel, Chesed, Hazo, Pildash, Jidlaph, and Bethuel
Kemuel was the father of Aram
